title: Recover satellite attitude state (q0, ω) from a single ground-based light curve

last_measured.summary: fast aliased 119 — which s112 said needs the IA Cloud Cross — is now RECOVERED BLIND WITHOUT the cross: anchor-direct ω-multistart per cloud rep lands winner rep 192 at q0 2.27°/ω-dir 1.64°/hi-fi-ρ 1.534 Band A (26 A∪B, 0 phantoms; ω uniquely determined, attitude multi-valued).
